o.text:
Etymology tree
Ancient Greek πίναξ (pínax)bor.
Aramaic פִּינְכָא (pīnəkā)
Classical Syriac ܦܝܢܟܐ (pīnəḵā)bor.?
Classical Persian پِنْگَان (pingān)bor.
Arabic فِنْجَان (finjān)bor.
Azerbaijani fincan
Borrowed from Arabic فِنْجَان (finjān), borrowed from Classical Persian پِنْگَان (pingān), possibly borrowed from Classical Syriac ܦܝܢܟܐ (pīnəḵā), from Aramaic פִּינְכָא (pīnəkā), borrowed from Ancient Greek πίναξ (pínax).
From zirehli (“armoured”) + şəxsi heyət (“personnel”) + daşıyıcı (“carrier”). Likely a calque from English.
